blocks.text: Verses 10–11 warn against moving an old boundary marker to take land from the fatherless. This belongs to a broader Proverbs concern: it can relate material outcomes to diligence and choices, yet it also directly condemns gaining advantage through exploitation or the denial of justice.

Proverbs 22:17–24:22 has unusually close sequences of themes and expressions with the Egyptian Instruction of Amenemope. This observation concerns the larger collection that includes Proverbs 23, rather than a direct claim about any one verse in this chapter.
